local_context.value: On the sandy Lake Wales Ridge: low ridge of gently rolling hills, porous sandy soil, elevation 157 ft. 11,006 housing units (2020); fast growth at city edges (Orlando and Disney access). No official drainage source.

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL: Oakland (historic district), Randa Ridge, Southern Dunes (golf, developed 1995-2005), Posner Park (Wikipedia); Hamilton Bluff (new-home community, listing site). Fewer than 3 from official sources.

place_entities.value: 1) Lake Eva Park (2009, with Aquatics Center). 2) Polk Hotel (now Landmark Baptist College). 3) Historic Oakland district. 4) Haines City Public Library, 111 N. 6th St.

permit_office.value: Building Division, Development Services Dept., 620 East Main Street, Haines City FL 33844, 863-421-3600. Contractors must register first.
